decision: Fix deposit-dead markdown links with a flatten-aware pack-time rewrite of relative hrefs, not by relocating root main.md into content/ and not by a naive ./content/ prefix strip.

governingRule.description: main.md is read from both a source checkout (where ./content/... resolves) and a consumer deposit (where C1 flatten removes content/). The transform that makes those trees differ must be explicit and tested. Bound #3937 synthesis 5466789356.

alternativesConsidered.option: Naive ./content/ -> ./ strip on main.md (and maybe REFERENCES.md)
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Bound critic measured it covers 46 of ~200 deposit-dead links and cannot express ../../main.md, the larger reverse instance of the same flatten.

alternativesConsidered.option: Relocate main.md to content/main.md so one spelling resolves in both trees
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Covers about half the defect with no new packaging machinery, but changes the harnessEntry root rule and ~216 tracked references under a blocks-release-tag deadline. A generalized rewrite covers both flatten directions without that blast radius.

alternativesConsidered.option: Ship REFERENCES.md so AC1 can demand every main.md link resolves
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: PR #3958 / #3601 keeps REFERENCES.md as repo-dev. Coordinate by dropping the markdown link, not by assuming the file ships.

whyWinner: A flatten-aware rewrite maps each relative target through its source path onto the packed layout, stamps an attested marker, and is asserted by the existing validate-links collector against an out-of-tree packed fixture. Source checkout spellings stay correct. Unshipped targets are named residuals rather than an unnamed remainder.
revisitTrigger: Revisit if main.md is relocated under content/ and the harnessEntry rule changes, or if a later pack starts shipping REFERENCES.md / repo-root docs/decisions / PROJECT.md so the residual snapshot should shrink.
